title: Property Maintenance QR sharing fixed
details: Property Maintenance ST0171 learners can now create and share their Evia progress QR
The shared QR uses the same anonymous progress format as the existing Bricklayer, Carpentry and Trowel routes
ST0171 progress sharing includes course dates, OTJ progress, covered KSBs, evidence-source coverage and current Milos targets without learner personal data
The QR remains compatible with Milos, Symi and Tinos course-progress exchange
summary: Evia v126 fixes the missing ST0171 route in the Share QR flow so Property Maintenance learners can share their course progress normally.
changes: Added ST0171 to Evia progress QR routing
Added Property Maintenance progress payload creation
Preserved the existing QR behaviour for all previously supported courses
Added the ST0171 sharing controller to the offline shell
Moved Evia and its offline cache to v126
Published a new in-app update notification
